name: Mantle of Spell Resistance
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 221, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 522
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 221, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 522
Aura moderate abjuration; CL 9th
Slot chest; Price 90,000 gp; Weight —
Description
This light mantle bears a variety of mysterious symbols. When worn over normal clothing or armor, this magical garment grants the wearer spell resistance 21.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, spell resistance; Cost 45,000 gp
